name: Avatar Controller
description: Possess the selected object: WASD drives it with a chase or first-person camera (Esc releases).
author: theprototype-app

name: Drivable Car
description: Spawn a jointed demo car; click its body in Interact mode (I) to claim it, then drive with WASD in Play mode while a simulation runs.
author: theprototype-app

name: Collectibles
description: One node makes an object collectible: click it or walk into it, it hides and counts. Shared or per-player score, with respawn and never-hiding checkpoints.
author: theprototype-app

name: Door & Keypad
description: A combination-lock keypad that opens an actuated door. Replicated, VR and desktop, with late-joiner catch-up.
author: theprototype-app

name: Dungeon Kit
description: Level generation toolbox: a seeded multi-floor dungeon generator (rooms, corridors, decor, torches) rendered as torch-lit stone — glowing, flickering flames, a capped light budget that favours the entrance hall — with a toolbox, a Dungeon node and the userData.play contract the app walks in play mode. The playable game is Dungeon Realms.
author: theprototype-app

name: Dungeon Realms
description: Co-op dungeon crawl on the Dungeon Kit: explore five torch-lit floors under a dusk sky, collect glowing gems to unseal the portal, stand on it together and climb to the dragon's hoard. A clickable start menu (mouse, keys or gamepad), pause and victory screens - every rule and readout a flow node. Requires the dungeon (Dungeon Kit) module.
author: theprototype-app

name: VR Essentials
description: Clickable starter interactables: button, lever, spawner, teleport pad, sound tile, target.
author: theprototype-app

name: Flow Toolkit
description: Example module: ships code-editable flow nodes (registerNodeDefs) that pair with per-object flows.
author: theprototype-app

name: Football
description: VR football in a floodlit glass arena: hit the floating ball with your hands and put it through the glowing gate. Pick a side, Start - a live scoreboard with a match clock, score lamps over each gate, last-touch attribution, modes, per-player records and a saved match log - every rule a flow node.
author: theprototype-app

name: FPS Player
description: Walk mode: mouse look with WASD, sprint, jump and crouch, on a capsule that peers can see.
author: theprototype-app

name: Health
description: Hit points for objects and players: damage and heal nodes, death and respawn, converging on every peer with no authority - an object's hp from core Counters, a player's on their own peer row.
author: theprototype-app

name: Music DJ
description: Two decks and a crossfader as audio devices: drop a track on a deck, scrub the platter, ride the pitch, fade between them - every peer hears the same position.
author: theprototype-app

name: Music FX
description: A four-channel mixer and five pedals - delay, reverb, filter, distortion, bitcrush - as audio devices. Cable them in any order; re-plug to re-order.
author: theprototype-app

name: Music Lab
description: A Piano, a Speaker, a Transport, a Drum machine and Sampler pads as audio devices: cable them, paint a beat, press Play - every peer hears the same beat.
author: theprototype-app

name: Music Voice
description: A Mic, a Looper, a Synth and a Theremin as audio devices: sing into the graph, loop what is patched in on the bar, play chords, wave a hand - every peer hears the same thing.
author: theprototype-app

name: Piano
description: One-octave synth keyboard - every peer hears and sees your notes.
author: theprototype-app

name: Sabers
description: A glowing blade held wherever you point - VR controller or desktop mouse - with hit sparks and peers seeing your blade.
author: theprototype-app

name: Tutorial Room
description: An in-scene onboarding room: signs and clickable stations teaching select, build, connect, flow and VR.
author: theprototype-app

name: Untangle
description: Untangle the graph: drag the dots until no edges cross, on a flat 2D board or around a 3D globe (great-circle arcs). 30 levels per mode that unlock as you solve them, progress and best times kept on your device, reset any time. Procedural and replicated, with generative audio - board pose, level and readouts as flow nodes.
author: theprototype-app

name: Waves
description: A VR wave shooter in a sunset arena: a gun in your hand (Blaster, Scatter or Beam) and an ability on your grip (Shield, Slow-mo or Pulse); five levels of grunts, runners and tanks march out of the portals toward your crystal - shoot them down before they breach it. Menu, how to play, loadout and options reachable in VR; best run saved; derived on every peer. Needs the health module.
author: theprototype-app
